description: One knob driving ten outputs, each output with its own attenuverter, so a single movement can send ten different voltages at once

params.text: The voltage the ten outputs are scaled from, -5V to +5V or 0V to 10V depending on the range switch
Scales the main knob voltage for that output, -1 to +1, so the output can be a fraction of it or the same fraction inverted; at the centre that output gives 0V
Chooses the range of the main knob: 0V to 10V in the 0v 10v position, -5V to +5V in the -5v +5v position

outputs.text: Carries the main knob voltage scaled by the attenuverter on its own row
